name: aias-advisor
description: Apply the AI Assessment Scale to explain, redesign and review educational assessments.

interface.longDescription:
Apply the AI Assessment Scale (AIAS) to your teaching and assessment context. Maintained by Learning Innovation Practice, the organisation responsible for the AIAS.

The adviser helps you understand the five task types, choose a level that fits your learning outcomes, redesign a brief, decide what evidence students should produce, and develop rubric criteria. You can also review an existing assessment for mismatches between its AIAS level, task, evidence and marking criteria.

Guidance uses the current AIAS 2.1 level wording and research on assessment design, implementation and language-learning contexts. It distinguishes current wording from earlier versions in the research papers.

This plugin contains instructions and reference materials. It has no connected service, publisher-operated server or external account sign-in. The package does not send your conversations or assessment briefs to Learning Innovation Practice. ChatGPT processes your inputs under the terms and data controls applicable to your account.

Advice is generated by AI and may not reflect the authors' views or the best choice for your context. Use your own judgement and your institution's policies. The adviser does not verify student authorship, make misconduct decisions or certify assessment validity.
defaultPrompt: Help me redesign an existing assessment using the AIAS.
Review whether my Level 3 assessment requires student judgement.
Explain the AIAS levels and what the padlock means.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with AIAS 2.1 guidance, assessment redesign and review, current level statements, diagrams and research references.
